detail.mode: 4 parallel deep-analysis agents, one per workbook group

scope.1a: Boat Module (4144-col matrix + hidden Dropdowns) + Hull Only
scope.1d: Service (63k rows) + Price Matrix + Rego + Freight + Admin + Customer + Contacts + BMT Stock + CSV

detail.rules: read-only on sources; customer PII masked in outputs; every mapping carries rationale + confidence + open questions

detail.decision: HelmLogic data model MAY flex to fit the MPF. Fidelity to MPF concepts takes priority over preserving existing HelmLogic schema; where the two conflict, reshape HelmLogic.
detail.qualityBar: Match MPF content exactly, but upgrade its FORM: typed fields not free text, explicit relationships not positional columns, one source per fact not formula webs, referential integrity, auditability.
detail.consequence: Phase 1 mapping table gains a third resolution besides map-to-existing / new-collection: RESHAPE existing HelmLogic schema. Phase 3 correction plan may include schema migrations, not just data patches.

headlines: Service Module is a CATALOG not a ledger: real data ends row 280 (189 Yamaha engine models with 11-interval service price matrices + 5yr plans + parts BOMs); 63k rows were phantom

Operation Codes sheet = serviceOperations analog: 366 flat-rate ops, Op Code natural key, labour 159 inc/130.09 ex GST; per-brand warranty labour rates (HelmLogic currently assumes ONE hourlyRate — schema flex candidate)

Price Matrix = pricing brain: per-franchise margins (Highfield 47.5% + trade tiers, Stabicraft 29%, Yamaha 11.5%, trailers 22%), retail sliding scale by price band, exchange rates NZ 1.2 / USD 0.7 / EUR 0.6
Boat-Module PD codes are DMS naming, do NOT resolve to Service Module rows; MPDC/DPDC are checklist text on the boat row
Registration catalog is QLD-only banded (needs explicit state wrap in Rego module)
Freight is per-linear-metre per-vendor (Highfield 128.47/lm +10%, Surtees 441.21/lm +5%)
Customer Module = 44 B2B dealer-network accounts keyed to price levels, NOT retail customers
BMT Stock Holdings = empty template; Contacts = staff directory
Phantom Excel dimensions in 5 of 9 files: all imports must bound-scan, never trust max_row
14 anomalies catalogued incl. orphan legacy ops with Sell<CTD (excluded) and 9SB/9SC prefix collision

Dealer Fit Module sheet: 1,795 DFOs across 95 sections with Act CTD/Act Sell (rollups value-verified) -> dealerFitSelections, VERY HIGH confidence — the literal origin of the Act Sell/Act CTD convention
Parts Maintenance: 3,532-code NSM parts master with install hours + Operation Code linkage -> fitUpItems + serviceOperations
Parts Data Drop: 26,347-row DMS inventory extract (164 franchises, stock-on-hand, bin) -> serviceParts; natural key Franchise+Part
Highfield accessories sheet: USD at hardcoded 0.7 FX, prices INC GST (convention breaker — flag for import normalisation)
15 vendor price lists (BLA/SAW/RWB/Garmin/etc) -> supplier cost-refresh sources; open decision: vendor-shared vs per-org
Rigging Kits: 961 part numbers in 26 sections, 3-tier ex-GST pricing + install at 130.09 shop rate -> NEW riggingKits collection (schema flex)
Supplier Module: 1,606-supplier registry -> NEW suppliers collection (schema flex)
SYSTEMIC FRAGILITY: cross-module joins are description-STRING keyed (Boat Module dealer-fit + rigging columns join by text via hidden Dropdowns) — quality upgrade = explicit typed IDs
Anomalies: Lowrance 65k ghost rows (445 real), ~135 dup part codes, keys with embedded spaces, NLA/#N/A inside part numbers, mixed GST bases, superseded vendor sheets retained

Boat Module real shape 2,301x678 (END marker col 678; 3,466 phantom cols). 2,003 real boats: 810 current / 1,193 obsolete (59.6% dead history); 633 Model Codes duplicated current-vs-obsolete — import decision required
Highfield: 588 current SKUs at EXACTLY HelmLogic variant grain (model x material x colour, e.g. HBC066)
Non-Highfield current: Stacer 91, Formosa 39, Stabicraft 37, Surtees 19, Merry Fisher 12, Cap Camarat 11, Haines 9, Jeanneau 4 — vendor-creation decision
29 column blocks mapped col-exact incl. 13 motor options at 6-col stride (motor/rigging/prop/engine-hole), 10 trailer options, 42 dealer-fit lines, hull-only ladder, paint, MPDC/DPDC
Relationship encoding = exact display-name STRINGS from hidden Dropdowns (426 trailers, 251 motors, 228 props, 514 rigging kits); Factory Options by code; props by Yamaha part number
Matrix column = brand key into Price Matrix (markup/discount brain), NOT a compatibility matrix
MPDC/DPDC = Mechanical/Detail Pre-Delivery CHECK LISTS (boilerplate text on ~1,964 rows), not charges

Landed-cost formula VERIFIED to the cent: (BaseCost+factory charges)/EXRate + OtherChg + RoadFreight; CL380 = 4504/0.7+300+490 = 7,224.29. Sell ladder: Cash=landed*1.5*1.1 INC GST hand-rounded; Trade x0.95; SubDealer x0.825; AUS Sailing x0.80; Warranty ~ landed*1.065
Hull Only Module = stale generated Highfield price list (16.06.2025) — reconciliation fixture, NOT an import source
Open questions: obsolete-row handling; inc-GST hand-rounded price storage; curated per-boat motor menu vs HP filter; per-brand markup matrix home; vendors for 8 non-Highfield brands

Motor price-level mapping CONFIRMED against production convention: NSM Retail->hull_cash, Trade->hull_trade+hull_subdealer (Dropdowns proves Trade==SubDealer), Commercial, Boating Alliance, Total CTD->cost. Campaign Sell Price has no HelmLogic slot (open decision)
Real extents: Motor Library 376 motors (header row 4); Trailer Module 470 trailers + OBSOLETE tail; FO Module 19,171 coded option rows in 706 boat sections + OBSOLETE section from row 19,068

Cross-module joins decoded + verified: motors by display string (13 slots + prop per slot, sentinel NR - ENGINE NOT REQUIRED); trailers by display name (483-name vocabulary, verified 3/3); factory options by CODE

HEADLINE ANOMALY (their data bug): Stabicraft boat rows reference FO codes that resolve almost entirely to the OBSOLETE FO section (e.g. Sportfish 0/57 active) — active section was re-keyed to 10-digit codes, Boat Module never migrated. Join fix verified via FO hull-row NSM code == Boat Module Model Code

FO pricing: per-brand implicit currency (Highfield USD/0.70, Merry Fisher+Jeanneau EUR x1.75); Sell semantics Std=standard inclusion, Bundle=pack member; 193 cached #N/A / #VALUE! errors frozen into values
Trailer rego = QLD flat 2-band table by ATM — confirms v1.4 info-only lesson
FO Dropdowns has a 200+ row data-island gap — defeats naive early-stop scans; bound-scan rule updated
HP strings lowercase 2 x 300; steering vocab Tiller/Remote/Mech-Hyd/DEC x4/DBW/SBW; 51 motor model codes duplicated across rig/campaign sections — col D not unique alone
